ratios.facility: Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement
ratios.quote: As of March 31, 2026, our Consolidated Leverage Ratio was approximately 4.14 to 1.00 versus our maximum covenant of 4.75 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: The covenant maximum was temporarily raised by the July 29, 2025 amendment: 4.75x for Q1-Q2 2026 and 4.25x for Q3-Q4 2026. After that it returns to 4.50x for Q1/Q2 and 4.00x for Q3/Q4. The leverage-based pricing grid sets only the interest rate margin and fee, so it is excluded; pricing is fixed at Tier 1 (>4.25x) through 2026.
